integrity: Analytical derivations are supplied in full; finite verification corroborates but is not an infinite proof. Known model, principal-branch formalism, and general signed-definiteness principles are credited. Supplemental material referred to by the motivating paper was not fully accessible; historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Local transverse exponential stability only. The one-impurity fold counts only the explicit curvature family; other winding and inverse-sine branches, basins, and nonlinear behavior at the fold are not classified.
title: A mixed-curvature stable branch and a sharp defect fold in a three-body oscillator ring
